description: This script analyzes Vitest test report files to identify the slowest test files based on their duration. It provides command-line options for configuration, report paths, and result limits, and it outputs a formatted list of top test files with their durations and test counts.

methods.name: parseVitestReportArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments related to Vitest report processing, providing options such as config, report path, and limit.

methods.name: loadVitestReportFromArgs
methods.description: Loads a Vitest report based on parsed command-line arguments.

methods.name: collectVitestFileDurations
methods.description: Collects and sorts file duration data from a Vitest report.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string.
